verdict.rationale: Bolt.new hosts projects, databases and published sites, so data residency is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region or residency for Bolt Database or Bolt hosting. The only related item is the option to use your own Supabase account for 'tighter control over your data'. That is a third-party, adjacent alternative, not Bolt's own region or residency selection, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
